difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the base change of a proper morphism is proper, and that the same holds for universally closed morphisms. The proof verifies the three constituents of the definition one after another: universal closedness is preserved by base change by definition, separatedness is preserved by base change by the corresponding lemma on separated morphisms, and being of finite type is preserved by base change by the base change lemma for finite type; properness, being the conjunction of the three, follows.
